<?php
trait Probe171Plain {
    public static function m(self $value): string { return self::class === $value::class ? 'scope;' : 'BAD;'; }
    public const CAPTURE = self::m(...);
}
$object = eval('return new class { use Probe171Plain; };');
$capture = $object::CAPTURE;
echo $object::class, ';', $capture($object);

<?php
trait Probe171String {
    public function __toString(): string { return 'string;'; }
    public static function m(self $value): string { return self::class === $value::class ? 'scope;' : 'BAD;'; }
    public const CAPTURE = self::m(...);
}
$object = eval('return new class { use Probe171String; };');
$capture = $object::CAPTURE;
echo $object::class, ';';
echo $object instanceof Stringable ? 'interface;' : 'BAD;';
echo $object, $capture($object);

<?php
class Probe171Base {}
interface Probe171I { public function label(): string; }
trait Probe171Chosen {
    public function __toString(): string { return 'string;'; }
    public function label(): string { return 'iface;'; }
    public static function m(parent $value): string { return 'chosen;'; }
}
trait Probe171Excluded {
    public static function m(parent $value): string { return 'excluded;'; }
    public const CAPTURE = self::q(...);
}
$object = include __DIR__ . '/child.php';
$capture = $object::CAPTURE;
echo $object::class, ';';
echo $object instanceof Stringable && $object instanceof Probe171I ? 'interfaces;' : 'BAD;';
echo $capture(new Probe171Base), $object, $object->label();

return new class extends Probe171Base implements Probe171I {
    use Probe171Chosen, Probe171Excluded {
        Probe171Chosen::m insteadof Probe171Excluded;
        Probe171Excluded::m as q;
    }

<?php
trait Probe171Repeat {
    public static function m(self $value): string { return self::class === $value::class ? 'scope;' : 'BAD;'; }
    public const CAPTURE = self::m(...);
}
$code = 'return new class { use Probe171Repeat; };';
$first = eval($code);
$second = eval($code);
$one = $first::CAPTURE;
$two = $second::CAPTURE;
echo $first::class, ';', $second::class, ';';
echo $one($first), $two($second);
try { $one($second); echo 'BAD;'; } catch (TypeError $error) { echo 'cross;'; }

<?php
trait Probe171NoParent {
    public function __toString(): string { return 'string;'; }
    public static function m(parent $value) { echo 'body;'; }
    public const CAPTURE = self::m(...);
}
echo 'before;';
$object = eval('return new class { use Probe171NoParent; };');
$capture = $object::CAPTURE;
echo 'captured;';
$capture(new stdClass);
echo 'BAD;';

function probe171Argument() { echo 'ARG;'; return 1; }
echo 'before;';
$object = include __DIR__ . '/child.php';
echo 'BAD;';

<?php
trait Probe171BadA { public function clash() { echo 'BAD;'; } }
trait Probe171BadB { public function clash() { echo 'BAD;'; } }
trait Probe171After {
    public static function m(self $value): string { return self::class === $value::class ? 'scope;' : 'BAD;'; }
    public const CAPTURE = self::m(...);
}
$code = 'if (false) { new class { use Probe171BadA, Probe171BadB; }; }
return new class { use Probe171After; };';
$object = eval($code);
$capture = $object::CAPTURE;
echo $object::class, ';', $capture($object);

<?php
$before = new class {};
echo $before::class, ';';
eval(<<<'CODE'
namespace Author171;
trait LeftSource {
 public function value(): string { return 'left'; }
 public static function take(self $value): string { return 'scope'; }
 public const CAPTURE = self::take(...);
}
trait RightSource { public function value(): string { return 'right'; } }
function make() {
 return new class implements \Stringable {
  use LeftSource, RightSource {
   LeftSource::value insteadof RightSource;
   RightSource::value as q;
   LeftSource::value as __toString;
  }
 };
}
$one = make();
$captured = $one::CAPTURE;
echo $one::class, ';', $one, ';', $one->q(), ';', $captured($one), ';';
$two = make();
echo $one !== $two ? 'fresh;' : 'bad;';
CODE);
$after = new class {};
echo $after::class;

<?php
trait Probe171Repeat {
    public static function m(self $value): string { return self::class === $value::class ? 'scope;' : 'BAD;'; }
    public const CAPTURE = self::m(...);
}
$code = 'return new class { use Probe171Repeat; };';
$first = eval($code);
$second = eval($code);
$one = $first::CAPTURE;
$two = $second::CAPTURE;
echo $first::class, ';', $second::class, ';';
echo $one($first);
try { $two($second); echo 'BAD;'; } catch (TypeError $error) {
    echo 'M:', $error->getMessage(), "\n";
    echo 'T:', $error->getTraceAsString(), "\n";
}
